title: Finish and honestly certify TransitVPN for Artiom's Beijing travel
acceptance_criteria: Before proposing or changing code, read PROJECT_BRIEF.md and the current maps under docs/archaeology/current; use those maps to reuse canonical owners and investigate every conflict relevant to the active increment.

Finish every requirement in PROJECT_BRIEF.md through small independently verified implementation, test-authoring and review increments; preserve the last working state and do not replace working behaviour with stubs, mocks or documentation-only claims.
Use current official Xray documentation and a pinned, hash-verified real Xray binary; validate generated server and client configurations and reject stale, malformed or unsupported shapes.

Keep credentials out of Git, prompts, logs, fixtures and evidence, proving the boundary with executable negative controls; generated runtime secrets must be ignored, permission-restricted and deterministically redacted.
Prove a real local server-to-client Xray tunnel, intended failure modes, restart behaviour, DNS and routing semantics, truthful recovery-path semantics, rollback, rotation, backup and health checks.

Produce runnable Linux deployment plus Mac and phone client-import and offline Beijing recovery artefacts, without claiming an unprovisioned recovery endpoint, public reachability or Beijing field success.
Finish and certify everything that does not require unavailable external infrastructure or authentication; report any genuine external-only blocker precisely without weakening local acceptance.

At completion, run the full clean suite, lint, config validation, credential scan and independent exact-source review; report implemented percentage, independently certified fraction, evidence identities and every remaining external or field-verification boundary.

payload.superseded_cause: ArtVault Codex transport consumed the zero-call planner budget for its mandatory stdin read before semantic planning; no project files changed.
